parameters.query:
WITH del AS (
  DELETE FROM voice_calls
   WHERE created_at < now() - interval '10 days'
   RETURNING 1
), aband AS (
  UPDATE voice_calls
     SET status = 'abandoned',
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE status = 'pending'
     AND started_at < now() - interval '6 hours'
   RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM del)   AS deleted_old_rows,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM aband) AS abandoned_pending_rows;
